label: A first being is in POTENCY_2 in no respect, from esse-cause priority
description: The composition route to the first being's pure actuality (firstBeingNoPotencyOfComposition) with the cause-to-efficient-cause bridge and efficient-cause priority replaced by one premise on the same cause-of-perfection relation as the q.3 a.7 cause premise: a distinct cause of a thing's esse is simply prior to it. A first being is in act in some respect; if it were in potency in another it would be composite, so it would have a distinct cause of its esse, which is simply prior to it, against firstness. No passage to efficient causing occurs. Conditional consequence only; no premise is established.
